title: Implement periodic refresh, IC canister storage, and file previews

requirements.text: Implement periodic polling mechanism in the frontend that automatically refreshes the file list every 3-5 seconds using React Query with refetchInterval

quotes: to implement periodic refresh/polling instead (e.g., files refresh every few seconds)

acceptanceCriteria: File list automatically refreshes every few seconds without manual user interaction
Polling can be paused when user is inactive to save resources
Loading states are handled gracefully without disrupting user experience

requirements.text: Implement file storage in Internet Computer canister storage with chunking strategy to handle size limits, storing file metadata and binary data as Blob chunks in stable memory

quotes: use the Internet Computer's canister storage (which has size limits per canister and costs cycles

acceptanceCriteria: Files are split into manageable chunks (e.g., 1-2MB per chunk) for storage
File metadata (name, size, type, owner, upload date) is stored separately from binary data
Chunks are reassembled correctly during download
Storage usage is tracked per user and globally

requirements.text: Create backend API methods for file upload (chunked), download (chunk retrieval and assembly), listing files with metadata, and deleting files
acceptanceCriteria: uploadFileChunk accepts file chunks with metadata and stores them in stable memory
downloadFile retrieves and returns all chunks for a given file ID
listFiles returns array of file metadata for the authenticated user
deleteFile removes all chunks and metadata for a file

requirements.text: Implement file preview functionality for TXT files (plain text display), images (PNG, JPG, GIF, SVG), videos (MP4, WebM), and documents (PDF) using browser-native rendering capabilities

quotes: want previews for TXT, images, videos, and docs

acceptanceCriteria: TXT files display content in a readable text viewer with syntax highlighting if applicable
Images render in an image viewer with zoom and pan controls
Videos play in a native HTML5 video player with standard controls
PDF documents render using browser's built-in PDF viewer or an embedded PDF renderer
Preview panel shows file type badge and fallback message for unsupported formats

requirements.text: Add periodic polling to the admin dashboard activity feed that refreshes every 5-10 seconds to show recent file operations and user actions
acceptanceCriteria: Admin activity feed automatically updates with latest system events
Activity entries show timestamp, user, action type, and affected file/resource
Polling interval is configurable and can be adjusted based on admin preferences

requirements.text: Implement storage quota tracking and enforcement per user with visual indicators showing used vs. available storage
acceptanceCriteria: Backend tracks total storage used per user across all their files
Upload operations fail gracefully when user exceeds quota with clear error message
Frontend displays storage usage as percentage with visual progress bar
Admin dashboard allows setting and modifying per-user storage limits

constraints: Must use Internet Computer canister storage, not external storage services
Cannot use WebSockets or real-time features; must use polling instead
File chunking is required to work within IC canister size limits
All file previews must use browser-native rendering capabilities only
nonGoals: Integration with external storage APIs like AWS S3 or Google Cloud Storage
Real-time synchronization using WebSockets or Server-Sent Events
Third-party preview services for complex document formats
Mobile native app development (focus on responsive web interface only)
